name: Tessel
summary: A slate and sea-teal business bank for a company with five shops, with a live city shop map
about: A business banking app for a small company with several shops and accounts, shown with a shoe retailer's five shops in Karachi. A drawn city map pings each shop as sales come in, its bubble growing through the day, and sweeps send money along the lines to HQ. Switch the whole app to one shop, approve managers' spend requests, freeze cards, move money with a confirm step and compare shops in reports.
how: Watch shop bubbles grow on the map; press a shop to see its takings and sweep settings
Pick a shop in the sidebar's Showing menu to filter every page to that shop
Press Sweep to HQ to move spare shop cash, and watch the lines on the map light up
Approve or decline spend requests one by one or in bulk; declines need a reason
Move money between accounts or to a supplier with a review step
Freeze cards, change limits, set each shop's float and export reports as CSV
